model: multidimensional probit item response: support when a.theta + b + e > 0, theta ~ N(0, I), e ~ N(0, 1)

estimation.items: tetrachoric correlations + unweighted least squares factor fit, converted to (a, b)
estimation.positions: hierarchical Gibbs sampling with items fixed: theta_i ~ N(mu_district, W), mu_district ~ N(0, T)
estimation.population_weights: unweighted (the hierarchical model conditions on district)

choose_k.rule: smallest K within one paired standard error of the best
